text: Venue A holds up to 40 people. In classroom layout Venue A seats 30 attendees. Venue B seats up to 60 people and includes a breakout room.
Venue A charges INR 45,000 per day. Venue B charges INR 60,000 per day including AV equipment.
Cancellations made more than 14 days before the event receive a full refund. Cancellations made within 14 days of the event forfeit the 25% booking deposit.
Approved refunds are processed within 10 business days to the original payment method.
Venue B offers on-site catering for groups of up to 80 guests. External caterers must be registered with the venue at least 7 days before the event.
Cancellations made more than 7 days before the event receive a full refund.
Employees are reimbursed for economy airfare and hotel stays of up to INR 8,000 per night when the claim is filed within 30 days of travel.
Domestic trips booked in advance through the corporate travel portal are reimbursed in full without additional approval.
All reimbursement claims must include itemised receipts; card statements alone are not accepted.
Approved reimbursements are paid with the next monthly payroll cycle.
International trips are reimbursed only when pre-approved by a department head, with a per-diem allowance of USD 75 per day.
Bookings made after travel has occurred require written approval from a senior director before reimbursement.
